cohort: Nulliparous women with singleton pregnancies ≥ 24 weeks' gestation diagnosed with preeclampsia at a single tertiary care center
finding: While the severity of preeclampsia and related complications were similar between older and younger nulliparous women, those over 40 had an increased risk of postpartum preeclampsia presentation or exacerbation and a higher rate of cesarean section.
mod_finding: The study found that women over 40 years old had an increased rate of cesarean section compared to younger gravidas.
